reviewItem.question: For "Removal of insecure configuration for exceptions: In prior versions, policy exceptions were allowed in all namespaces", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether the installation explicitly enables policy exceptions and sets the allowed namespace; the controlling configuration key is not named in the evidence

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes its defaults so policy exceptions are disabled and may only be created in a specified namespace (previously allowed in all namespaces, CVE-2024-48921); environments relying on PolicyExceptions must follow the upgrade guidance to keep them working.
